summary: Iteration 12 backend + frontend testing for FleetCare's large batch (bug fix + new features). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASS covering undo suspend/reactivate (bug fix), rata paid/unpaid, suspend planned_reactivation, reactivate deadline shift, suspension-pdf, /policy/auto-reactivate/run, /dashboard/timeline, maintenance interval_km, view_bollo permission scoping, and vehicle type weight persistence. Frontend: verified via Playwright that Timeline4Weeks section renders on Dashboard, fleet-tipo-select and monitor-tipo-select filters present, PolicyDialog contains all required testids (policy-recalc-dates, policy-rata-status, rata-paid/unpaid buttons toggling correctly, suspend-button, planned-reactivation-input, suspension-pdf-button, reactivate-shift-box), Settings has suspension-letter-text and vtype-new-weight, and manage-policy-button opens PolicyDialog. Rata badge color logic verified visually: 'Pagata' green when paid, 'Da pagare' amber when unpaid, 'Scaduto' red (never 'Regolare' green for unpaid rata).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 2617 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules (auth, vehicles, policies, maintenance, reports, strategy, cron).

VehicleCard edit/duplicate testids are suffixed with the targa (edit-vehicle-button-<tid>) rather than plain 'edit-vehicle-button' as described in the review spec. Not a blocker but tests written against the doc-style testids would fail. Consider aliasing or updating the review doc.
In auto-reactivate (server.py:2412), when planned_reactivation < current_suspension_start it silently clamps end=today; consider surfacing this rather than silently overriding the requested date.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testids verified for the requested features
